PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL
Government Notifications
NOTICE UNDER THE REGISTRATION OF ELECTORS ACT, No. 44 OF 1980 AS AMENDED BY THEREGISTRATION OF ELECTORS (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 10 OF 2017
WHEREAS certain persons have been internally displaced as a result of any actions of a terrorist militant or other groupduring the recent past :
02.Whereas in terms of Section 2 of the Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Act, No. 10 of 2017.any citizen of Sri Lanka :
2.1 who is or had been an internally displaced person ;
2.2 whose name appeared in the register of electors for any electoral district for any year, until the end ofthe year 2009 ; and
2.3 whose name has not been entered in any register in operation subsequent to the year 2009,

shall on proof of the above matters and on production of a certificate issued by the Grama Niladhari of the areain which he is presently residing, to the effect that he is or had been an internally displaced person, be entitled to makean application to the registering officer of the electoral district within which he was permanently resident prior to May18, 2009, to be registered in the register of electors of such electoral district ;
03.And whereas in terms of Section 2(3) of the aforesaid Special Provisions Act, the children of a citizen ofSri Lanka referred to in paragraph 2 above ;

3.1 who had not attained the age of eighteen years on the date on which such citizen became an internallydisplaced person and have attained the age of eighteen years or more on the date on which the revisioncommenced in respect of the register in operation, at the time in which the application is made,

3.2 who are born after such citizen became an internally displaced person and have attained the age ofeighteen years or more on the date on which the revision commenced in respect of the register inoperation, at the time in which the application is made ; and
3.3 whose name has not been entered in any register in operation subsequent to the year 2009,

shall on production of the birth certificate of such child sought to be registered and a certificate issued by theGrama Niladhari of the area in which he is presently residing on proof of the above matters, be entitled to make anapplication to the registering officer of the electoral district within which he/his parents was/were permanently residentprior to May 18, 2009, to be registered in the register of electors of such electoral district ;

04.In terms of the powers vested in the Election Commission under the Registration of Electors (SpecialProvisions) Act, No. 10 of 2017, we do hereby notify that the receipt of applications for the preparation of a supplementaryregister of electors for the year 2017 including the names of those who meet the requirements specified in paragraphs 02and 03 above will commence on 13th day of October 2017 and will close on 19th day of October 2017 ; that relevantapplication forms could be obtained from the offices of the registering officers of all electoral districts in Sri Lanka ; andthat dully filled applications be submitted to the relevant registering officers.

05.We do further notify that it is expected to finalize the preparation of the supplementary register referred toin paragraph 04 above on 20th day of October 2017 and the notice thereon to be issued on that day itself and that is alsoexpected to allocate additional time period of 14 days for those who fulfill the requirements specified above and whosenames are not entered in the said supplementary register to make appeals to enter their names in the supplementaryregister.
MAHINDA DESHAPRIYAN. J. ABEYSEKERES. RATNAJEEVAN H. HOOLEChairmanMemberMember
